chapters.title: Prologue
chapters.intro: A short, scripted opening. There's nothing to miss here, so enjoy it.

chapters.title: Just Like Paradise
chapters.intro: Island life in the Keys. Most of the game's permanent missables live in this chapter, almost all of them around Jason's house. Settle in, poke around the swamps and don't rush the ending.

chapters.title: Paradise Lost
chapters.intro: A fresh start somewhere less glamorous. One mid-chapter mission opens up switching and a burst of side content. The mountains are worth the drive.

chapters.title: Tits Ass Drug Money
chapters.intro: The city opens up. Robbery systems, street racing and a lot of side characters arrive. One timed race, one choice with a follow-up and two in-mission pickups need attention.

chapters.title: Vice City, Baby
chapters.intro: A long heist arc with a stretch where the two leads can't be seen together. Two side missions can be lost, so watch the warnings.

chapters.title: Top of the World, Ma
chapters.intro: The finale. Endings are reported to depend on choices, relationship, criminal profiles and money. Mission names here are hidden by default.

chapters.title: After the Credits
chapters.intro: Free roam continues and the 100% checklist unlocks. Nothing on it can be missed. Take your time.

activities.title: Set up the game for a completionist run
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Turn on every progress and collectible notification under Settings > UI, including Criminal Profile updates. You'll get a quiet ping whenever something counts.
activities.whyNow: Costs a minute and means you never wonder whether a find registered.

activities.title: Prologue
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: The game's opening. Basic on-foot controls and a scripted chase. Nothing in the Prologue can be missed.
activities.whyNow: There's no free roam yet. Play it straight; the outcome is scripted, so don't hunt for a better route.

activities.title: Make a permanent chapter-entry save
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: You get 15 manual save slots plus one autosave. There's no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep one slot for the start of every chapter and never overwrite it.
activities.whyNow: Guides agree this is the single best protection against missing anything.

activities.title: Gone Fishing
unlocks: Jason's Key Lento house: wardrobe, cash stash, deck gym, TV
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Your first real outing in the Keys. Completing it gives you Jason's Key Lento house (wardrobe, cash stash, deck gym, TV) plus binoculars and a flashlight.
activities.whyNow: Opens your home base and the binoculars you'll use for wildlife study all game. Watch for loose cash during the mission.

activities.title: Spare cash on the way out

missable.warning: Inside this mission only. If you finish the mission without it, it's gone for good.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: During your first swamp job there's money lying around that you can't come back for once the mission ends.
activities.whyNow: One-time pickup inside a mission. Once you're airborne it's gone.
hints: While you're out in the swamp on this job, keep your eyes open. There's money nobody is guarding.
Someone mentions it in passing. It's on the route back to the plane.
Look inside the red-and-white trailer at the swamp camp before you board.
Cash sits in the red-and-white trailer at the Kingfisher camp in the Pelican Valley swamp; Donnie mentions it. Grab it on the way to the plane. The amount isn't documented.

activities.title: Know how your criminal profile works
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Every character builds a criminal profile from how you play. Limb shots and stealth lean Professional; kills lean Psycho. Reaching Irredeemable is permanent for that character, and the ending is reported to consider your profile.
activities.whyNow: Easier to steer from the start than to fix later. If you want every option open at the end, stay below Irredeemable.
activities.notes: PC Gamer, quoted in project research: once you have an Irredeemable profile, it's permanent. How much the profile affects the ending is reported but not fully documented.

activities.title: Start studying wildlife with binoculars
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Study animals you come across with the binoculars. 100% needs 100 of 255, and every dog and cat breed counts separately.
activities.whyNow: Free and passive. It piles up over 60 to 80 hours if you start now, so there's no grind later.

activities.title: Reading material around the house

missable.warning: These spots are lost when you leave the house for good at the end of Chapter 1. Other copies exist, so the 100% magazine count is still reachable.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Jason's house has several things to read, inside and out. These spots won't be reachable after this chapter. Copies exist elsewhere for the magazine total, but this is the easy moment.
activities.whyNow: The house is your base for all of Chapter 1 and then it's gone. Five quick pickups now save a hunt later.
hints: Take a slow lap of the house. Reading material turns up inside, below and out back.
Check the bedroom, the living room, a table by a window, the shed under the house and the back deck.
Bedside table; living-room table; table by the east window; workbench in the shed under the house; back deck by the weights.

Ashes of Glory (bedside table), Lethal by Design (living-room table; a Liberty City memoir, a GTA IV nod), Orca: A Whole Different Animal (table by the east window), Off the Hook (shed workbench; it also marks fishing hotspots on your map) and Body Copy (back deck by the weights). Magazines count toward 30 of 34 for 100%.

activities.title: Look closely at the yard and the TV
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Jason's place hides a couple of nods for long-time fans of the series. Small, but you won't be able to look for them after this chapter.
activities.whyNow: Environmental storytelling, and the house won't be accessible after Chapter 1.
hints: Jason's house has a couple of little winks for series fans.
One is outside in the yard. The other plays on screen indoors.
Check the navigation screen on the boat in the yard. Leave the TV on for a while.
The boat's GPS in Jason's yard shows a map of Los Santos (GTA V). A Weazel News report about the skunk ape plays on the TV.

activities.title: Gear Up
activities.safeTitle: A trip to the gun store
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Opens Ammu-Nation and longarms. Body armor and a parachute are on sale at the Key Lento Ammu-Nation.
activities.whyNow: Exploration in the swamps gets dangerous. You want armor and a rifle before you go looking for the good stuff.
activities.notes: Ultimate Edition: Jason's engraved Girardi ES9 appears in the weapon locker after this mission (Output Lag).

activities.title: Lab Fees
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Introduces the duffel bag and your first fence.
activities.whyNow: You'll be picking up valuables from now on. This gives you somewhere to carry and sell them.

activities.title: Just a Scratch
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Repairs and resprays at Coastal Auto Care. The mechanic will also bring your car to you during Chapter 1.
activities.whyNow: Quick, and car delivery saves a lot of walking in the Keys.

activities.title: Unwanted Attention
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Adds the police scanner app. Most guides also place the WAiNK scanning app here.
activities.whyNow: WAiNK scanning (vehicles, landmarks) is the cheapest long-term progress in the game. Start it early.
activities.notes: Conflict: one guide delays the full WAiNK tutorial to Chapter 2's Moses.

activities.title: Start scanning vehicles with WAiNK
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB, to scan vehicles. 100% needs 200 of 277 base models. Boats and aircraft count too. Landmarks you scan count toward a separate 100-location target.
activities.whyNow: It's free while you drive around anyway. Starting now means you'll hit 200 naturally.
activities.notes: Unlock point is disputed (Unwanted Attention vs Moses in Chapter 2). The 200 of 277 requirement is consistent across sources; one page also cites 557 including variants.

activities.title: Keep an eye out for flamingos, cards and hoops
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Three long-running collections start now: special flamingos (only those with a black-and-white beak count; 100 of 125), collectible cards (15 of 18 sets) and basketball hoops (90 of 100). Grab them when you pass them; don't hunt yet.
activities.whyNow: None of these can be missed and none are needed now. Noticing them early just makes cleanup shorter.

activities.title: The outpost in the swamp
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Deep in the swamp country, an abandoned outpost is hiding more than it lets on. Bring patience and a curious mind. There's a unique reward, and something guarding it.
activities.whyNow: Reachable in the first hours of Chapter 1 and one of the best early finds. It turns a quiet swamp trip into a small mystery.
hints: Head into the Pelican Valley swamp. Somewhere out there, a cluster of old shacks has a story to tell.
Look for an abandoned research outpost: a main building and several shacks. Power is the first problem to solve.
Restore power at the electrical box behind the main building. The floorboards hold a password, a computer and a safe hold the rest, and the first shack's keypad door is the goal.

Switch on the electrical box at the back of the main building; examine the floorboards for passwords; log into the PC with CLEAVES (the buttons shuffle); a giant crab attacks when you back out of the PC; open the safe next to the PC with 0072; the first shack's keypad door code is 0212. Inside: the Crabshack VF5 (unique Vom Feuer VF5 SMG) and a stash bag of marked bills.
activities.notes: Single detailed source (Output Lag). GTA6 GPS has a pin labelled 'crab gun' that likely matches.

activities.title: A cabin nobody came back from
activities.region: Pelican Valley swamp, southwest of Hamlet
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Somewhere in the wetlands, a wrecked cabin tells a grim story. Two unique rewards wait for anyone willing to wade in. No fight, but the water isn't friendly.
activities.whyNow: Two unique finds in one stop, both available now, and a strong bit of environmental storytelling.
hints: The swamps west of Hamlet hide a place that went very wrong for someone. It's worth the wade.
Southwest of Hamlet, in the middle of the Pelican Valley swamp. Watch the water on the way in.
Find the wrecked cabin in the middle of the swamp. Search the main room, including its far side.
Swamp Bait Akulus Revolver lies on the blood-covered floor in the middle of the room. Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 sniper rifle sits on the far side with sniper ammo. No enemies inside.
activities.notes: Sportskeeda's summary places the Akulus 'on the floor of a marsh, southwest of Hamlet', consistent with Output Lag.

activities.title: The island Donnie talks about
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Remember the island someone mentioned early on? The crew who holds it keeps something worth taking. Expect heavy resistance.
activities.whyNow: A unique reward that rewards preparation. Do it once you have armor and a longarm.
hints: An island mentioned in passing early in the chapter is home to a rival crew, and they keep something special.
Approach by boat. The prize is inside their fishing shack.
Clear the armed crew at the Kingfishers' fishing shack and open the weapon case inside.

Kingfishers W-22 small game rifle (comes with scope and suppressor) in a weapon case inside the Kingfishers' fishing shack on the island Donnie mentions. One map pins it in Mariana County. A big armed crew guards it; bring armor.

activities.title: The run-down motel south of Hamlet

missable.warning: Unconfirmed: one guide says driving off to lose the police can board up the room for good. Save before entering.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: A tired roadside motel has more going on in its rooms than it should. A unique reward is inside, but it may not stay accessible if you leave in a hurry.
activities.whyNow: Available now. Save before you go in, because one report says the rooms can board up for good.
hints: A motel on the road south of Hamlet, with a striped mascot out front, is worth a closer look.
Loot the first room, then check the room next door. Expect company.
The prize is in the second room. A second crew arrives and the police may follow. Finish inside before you flee.

Kingfishers Laird 350 sporting sniper rifle, in the second room of the run-down tiger motel south of Hamlet. A second crew arrives; cops may follow. If you drive off to lose the cops, the room may board up and stay shut.
activities.notes: Output Lag places it south of Hamlet; GTA6 GPS has a 'Kingfisher Laird 350' pin in a different region. Boarding-up risk is single-source.

activities.title: Gunshots on a country road
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: If you hear gunfire on the rural roads, don't drive away. Helping a stranger can pay off in a unique way.
activities.whyNow: A random encounter, so it can't be scheduled. Just keep this in mind while you're out exploring.
hints: Out on quiet country roads, gunfire isn't always a threat. Sometimes it's a call for help.
Follow gunshots near dirt roads in the countryside.
Two men by a dirt road, one of them wounded. Offer to help and get him to medical care fast.
Drive the wounded hunter to the hospital in his own truck; he hands you the Hunter's Laird 350 sporting sniper rifle. Random encounter; location isn't fixed.

activities.title: Stranded at sea
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Getting stuck far out at sea isn't always a disaster. Someone unexpected might come to the rescue.
activities.whyNow: Pure delight, and there's something worth finding at the end. Try it any time you have a boat or jet ski.
hints: If you ever find yourself stranded far from shore, wait. Help may arrive in an unusual form.
Get stranded out on the open water rather than swimming back.
A rescuer on a jet ski can take you somewhere you wouldn't otherwise find. Look around when you arrive.
When stranded at sea, a dog on a jet ski picks you up and carries you to an island full of dogs. A hidden wallet with $1,218 is reported there. Exact trigger conditions aren't fully documented.

activities.title: Pipework
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: A rent collection that needs the four earlier jobs done first. Watch the floor before you leave.
activities.whyNow: Unlocks the next stretch of side content, including the neighbor's errands.

activities.title: Something dropped during the rent call

missable.warning: Only available during this mission.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: During this rent collection, the tenant drops something you might want to keep. You can't come back for it.
activities.whyNow: One-time pickup inside a mission.
hints: Something small changes hands during this visit. Keep your eyes down.
Check the floor before you leave the house.
The tenant tosses something on the floor. Pick it up before walking out.
Mandy throws a Macizo cigar on the floor. Pick it up before leaving her house. Its use isn't documented.

activities.title: Help the neighbor (part 1)
activities.region: Key Lento, next to Jason's house

missable.earliest: After the first four Key Lento jobs
missable.warning: Both neighbor errands vanish once Tourist Trap starts. Not needed for trophies or 100%, but you won't see them again.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Jason's neighbor could use a hand. Small errands, but they disappear for good once the chapter's endgame starts.
activities.whyNow: Permanently missable and right next door. Do both parts now while you're living here.
hints: The neighbor next door has a small favor to ask.
Look for her marker right by Jason's place in Key Lento.
Talk to Shirley next door. The first errand is a supply run to a store.

Get Shirley's Rum. A hidden stash of about $1,300 is reported in a parrot cage during this errand. One guide adds that asking the clerk about bird noises reveals an Exotic Animals Front activity. Followed by Steal the Scooter.

activities.title: Help the neighbor (part 2)

missable.warning: Vanishes once Tourist Trap starts.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: The neighbor's second, final errand.
activities.whyNow: Same deadline as part 1.
hints: Shirley has one more thing she needs.
Her second errand starts from the same spot.
It involves a set of wheels that isn't yours.
Steal the Scooter. Reward isn't documented. Neither Shirley errand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

activities.title: Hey Arnold!
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Contains a choice. Guides disagree on its weight: one says it's logged permanently on your criminal profile; another says it creates no story branch.
activities.whyNow: Next on the path. Save first.
activities.notes: Choice: kill or spare Arnold (Output Lag: recorded on criminal profile; Dork: no story branch).

gate.title: A choice is coming
gate.warning: This mission contains a choice that may be logged on your criminal profile. There's no mission replay.
gate.save: Make a manual save before you start, so you can live with your decision or reload.

activities.title: Island Dreams
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Introduces diving, treasure hunting and the metal detector.
activities.whyNow: Opens an entire treasure-hunting questline and the metal detector. Big exploration value.

activities.title: Treasure dives with Kenton
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Kenton has more dives for you a little while after your first one. It's a long treasure-hunting chain across several shipwrecks, with underwater discoveries along the way.
activities.whyNow: Start it now. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so nothing is lost, but the first sets are here in the Keys.
hints: After your first dive, give it some time. Kenton will want you back.
Look for a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento.
Each set is a shipwreck with several underwater discoveries. The metal detector helps.

7 shipwreck sets in total; 100% needs 5 of 7 sets plus all 33 underwater discoveries. Kenton pauses after Chapter 1 and returns between Chapters 2 and 3 (calling Brian as Jason reportedly speeds it up). Not missable.
activities.notes: Sources disagree on the 100% requirement (PowerPyx: 5 of 7 sets; Game-Checklists: all 7). A Kenton trophy ('This Was No Boat Accident') appears in project research, but PowerPyx's trophy list doesn't show a Kenton trophy. Unconfirmed.

activities.title: Feng Shui
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Unlocks the home console games. Afterwards, a set of errands for Lucia appears; they only count before the next story mission.
activities.whyNow: The errands it opens set your starting relationship level. Stop after this mission and do them.

activities.title: Get ready for Lucia's return

missable.warning: These errands only count before Coming Home. After that, the chance to set the starting relationship level is gone.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: A handful of small errands appear: groceries, flowers, a gift, a haircut and some clothes. They only count before the next story mission, and together they set your starting relationship level.
activities.whyNow: Relationship level is reported to feed into the ending. These are quick and they expire at the next mission.
hints: Someone's coming home soon. A few thoughtful errands around Key Lento will make a difference.
Check the map after Feng Shui for small purple errand markers around Key Lento.
Groceries (pick up and drop off), flowers, a necklace, a haircut and clothes from a friend.

Pick Up / Drop Off Groceries, Buy Flowers, Buy Lucia a Necklace (The Siren's Chest), Get The Chop (Barnacle Beauties), Get Lucia's Clothes (from Andy at the Manatee's Rest). They count only before Coming Home. The necklace has a small follow-up early in Chapter 2.

activities.title: Fix up the house

missable.warning: Repairs count toward the relationship only before Coming Home.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: The house needs a little work: the roof and a bedroom wall. It counts toward getting ready for Lucia.
activities.whyNow: Counts before Coming Home, and the house is lost at the end of the chapter.
hints: The house isn't quite ready for a guest.
Look up, and look at the bedroom walls.
Interact with the damaged roof tiles and the bedroom plasterboard.
Fix the roof tiles and the bedroom plasterboard. One guide says repairs count only before Coming Home; another lists them as a before-Tourist-Trap task.

activities.title: A fishing challenge from Cal
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Cal sends a friendly challenge a little while after Feng Shui. A relaxed fishing outing with a trophy attached.
activities.whyNow: Fishing is open from free roam already, and this is a gentle way into it.
hints: Cal thinks he can out-fish you. Wait for his text.
The challenge is in Gambit Bay.
You need a specific species above a certain weight. The Off the Hook magazine in Jason's shed marks hotspots.
Catch a Bigger Fish: a stoplight parrotfish over 2 lb in Gambit Bay. Earns Baited My Tackle.

activities.title: Play the games on Jason's TV
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Jason's TV has three playable games. They count toward 100% and the Master of None trophy. They're unavailable for most of Chapter 2 and come back in Chapter 3.
activities.whyNow: A cozy break between jobs. Not permanently missable.
activities.notes: Games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind. The fourth for 100% (Bang For Your Buck) is on arcade machines.

activities.title: Coming Home
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Closes the window for Lucia's pre-release errands and house repairs.
activities.whyNow: Only start it once the errands are done.

activities.title: Clean Up After Donnie
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Can be played before or after the next mission. Opens Donnie's drop-off for selling narcotics at better rates.
activities.whyNow: Unlocks a better narcotics fence that disappears later in the chapter.

activities.title: Buck Me
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Sets up BuckMe banking and Family Savings. Family Savings can't be withdrawn, but it raises limits and gives perks.
activities.whyNow: Banking is how money survives the end of this chapter.
activities.notes: One report places the RydeMe fast-travel app here; another says after Chapter 2. Until then, taxis go anywhere for about $100.

activities.title: Bank your money

missable.warning: Pocket cash, the floor stash and anything not in Family Savings won't carry over past Tourist Trap. Sources disagree on whether regular BuckMe balances survive.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Deposit cash into BuckMe and put money into Family Savings. Cash in your pocket and in the house stash won't carry past the end of this chapter.
activities.whyNow: Guides recommend moving at least $5,000 into Family Savings before the chapter's final missions.

activities.title: Down to Earth
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Afterwards, a quiet at-home moment becomes available the next morning.
activities.whyNow: Unlocks the chapter's most important missable. Don't advance past it without doing it.

activities.title: A quiet morning at home

missable.latestSafe: Before starting Tourist Trap (Recalibration is the last call)
missable.earliest: The morning after Down to Earth
missable.warning: Permanently missable at the end of Chapter 1, and possibly required for the Positive Mental Attitude trophy. Do it the morning after Down to Earth.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: One morning soon, Lucia offers a quiet moment at home. Say yes. It's the only chance in this chapter, and it may count toward a trophy.
activities.whyNow: The guide's top missable. It costs two minutes.
hints: An at-home moment with Lucia appears one morning soon. Accept it when it's offered.
Morning, in the kitchen, after Down to Earth.
Talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony. Choose Accept.

Balcony meditation with Lucia. One of 18 meditation spots (15 needed for 100%). It may be required for Positive Mental Attitude: PowerPyx is unsure, KeenGamer and LFCarry say yes, Output Lag says the trophy may unlock without it. Gone after Chapter 1.

activities.title: Something lost in the swamp
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: An optional search job appears after Down to Earth.
activities.whyNow: Optional black-icon missions can disappear as the story moves on. Do it while it's on the map.
hints: Something valuable went missing out in the wetlands.
It's an optional mission marker after Down to Earth.
Search four separate swamp areas.
Find the Lost Drugs: search four swamp areas. No guide marks it missable, but optional missions can vanish as the story moves on.

activities.title: A flyer about a legend
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: A local enthusiast is hunting something most people think is a myth. It starts with a flyer and only happens after dark.
activities.whyNow: A memorable, slightly ridiculous side story that counts toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
hints: Locals in the Keys and swamps talk about something big in the wetlands. Someone is offering to prove it.
Look for a flyer on a wall. One is at a bar in Hamlet.
Read the flyer at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet, then call the number. Go at night.
Kirk: Search for the Skunk Ape (Skunk Apeology 101). Night only. Read one of his flyers (Skeeter's bar, Hamlet) and call him. Part 1 of 3; counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

activities.title: The legend hunter's next lead
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Kirk has another lead, out in the valley.
activities.whyNow: Keeps the strand moving; the last part needs Chapter 2.
hints: Your new friend has found more signs.
Pelican Valley.
Look for markers left in the trees.
Kirk: Search for Tree Effigies, in Pelican Valley. Part 2 of 3. Part 3 opens in Chapter 2 (Lucia, at night).

activities.title: Day Release
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Can be swapped with the next mission.
activities.whyNow: Next on the path.

activities.title: Pick Lucia up from work

missable.latestSafe: Before 4 p.m. on the day she calls
missable.warning: Pick her up before 4 p.m. One guide says it may need relationship level 3 of 4 to appear.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: If Lucia calls, answer. Picking her up on time is a small gesture that counts.
activities.whyNow: Raises your relationship. Time-limited on the day it appears.
hints: Keep your phone handy. Lucia might need a ride.
Answer her call and head to where she works in Key Lento.
Key Lento Community Center, before 4 p.m.
Clock Out: answer Lucia's call; reach the Key Lento Community Center and pick her up before 4 p.m. Raises relationship. May need relationship at 3/4 to trigger (Dork).

activities.title: Clear Skies
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: A job in Southwind.
activities.whyNow: Next on the path.

activities.title: Building a Life
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: House work and a gun lesson with Lucia.
activities.whyNow: Next on the path.

activities.title: Sell narcotics at the good rate while you can

missable.warning: Donnie's Drop-Off is gone once Swamped is complete. You can still fence narcotics elsewhere at lower rates.

activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Donnie's drop-off pays better for narcotics than later fences. It closes when you finish the next story mission.
activities.whyNow: Higher payouts now, and narcotics fencing counts toward a 100% target.

activities.title: Swamped
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Closes Donnie's drop-off.
activities.whyNow: Sell narcotics at Donnie's first.

activities.title: Don Gone
activities.spoilerFreeDescription: Has a one-time pickup inside. Check every compartment before things get messy.

researchGaps.detail: Mission order, unlocks and what's lost at Starting From Zero are the least documented parts of the game. Dork's late chapters were still being filled in.
Only 4 of the 8 qualifying strands are confirmed (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete). Bret, Randy, Dunk and Kenton are unstated.

researchGaps.area: Balcony meditation and Positive Mental Attitude
researchGaps.detail: Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is strictly required for the trophy is disputed.
Guides disagree on whether trusting or not trusting him at the motel unlocks part 3. The Vapid 32 Hustler reward is single-source.
English guides say Power Play closes it; one Polish guide says it isn't time-limited. Needs an in-game test.
Exact expiry for Race Against Yago and the Shayna pickup is undocumented, as is whether sleeping advances the timer.
WAiNK (Unwanted Attention vs Moses), RydeMe (Buck Me vs after Chapter 2), large bank vaults (end of Chapter 4 vs Chapter 5).
Sources disagree on whether regular BuckMe balances survive Tourist Trap or only Family Savings (up to $5,000).

Only Output Lag gives detailed locations. Eight more names come from approximate map pins or search summaries (Sandstorm ES9, Silver 1922, Honky-Tonk Mustang .357, Stars and Stripes 556, Woodhatch Long Shot, Clunker 556, Cockroach Xtreme 556, Kingpin Heathen, Backdoor Hobo). Several pins have Chinese-only labels.
An abandoned research facility behind keypad code 2314 is reported with no confirmed location. Wyman's Classic Car Collection (car-hunt commission) has no documented trigger, count or locations.
Per-chapter card maps, meteorite totals and gold-doubloon totals aren't published. WAiNK location totals conflict (31 vs 112 listed; 100 required).
Collect Moses' Gift, Steal the Scooter, Gone Fishing trailer cash amount, Mandy's cigar use and the Shayna pickup reward are undocumented.
Beyond the wounded hunter and the jet-ski dog, random-event lists weren't verified for this version.
Reported factors are choices, relationship, criminal profiles and money invested. The number of endings and the weight of each factor aren't confirmed.

changelog.note: First version. Built from the three project research documents, cross-checked against launch-week guides (PowerPyx, Dork, Game-Checklists, FinalBoss, Output Lag, GTABase, WikiGTAVI).
